# Official notice parser fixtures

These fixtures contain normalized public notice body text inside a minimal `UCAP-CONTENT` HTML wrapper. They are extracted from the following State Council annual notices and verify the parser against human-checked holiday dates, combined holidays, weekends and December/January boundaries. They do not execute HTML or scripts.

- 2023: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-12/08/content_5730844.htm
- 2024: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202310/content_6911528.htm
- 2025: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202411/content_6986383.htm
- 2026: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm
